DE.source: Runtime-calibrated from the SOG SciPy differential-evolution profile

UPSO.source: SOG UPSO-labelled validation notebook and legacy unified-swarm controls

GIVP.source: Optuna multi-scenario tuning round 2 (study givp_hydropower_multiscenario_v2, trial 26/50; scenarios typical, upstream_peak, wet_rising, flood; n_eval_seeds=2; DE-normalized objective; warm-started from round-1 best config plus single-scenario typical/upstream_peak/wet_rising studies)

notes: Round 2: GIVP block re-tuned focusing on the 4 scenarios that still lagged after round 1 (typical, upstream_peak, wet_rising, flood), warm-started from the round-1 winning config (interop/v1/tuned_hyperparameters.json) so dry_stable/downstream_dominant gains are not blindly discarded.
early_stop_threshold was rescaled from the tuning budget (max_iter=30, tuned value 25) to the deployment budget (max_iterations=80) preserving the tuned ratio: round(25/30*80)=67.
DE, PSO, and UPSO profiles are unchanged from balanced_hyperparameters.json so any measured difference is attributable to the GIVP configuration alone.
This profile is for a balanced-runtime comparison and must not be described as an exact historical SOG replay.
Final comparisons use the paired reproducible seeds 44 through 48 for every algorithm.
Validate on all 7 scenarios (not just the 4 tuned) to check for regressions on dry_stable/downstream_dominant relative to round 1.
